blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Recent 3D world models generate photorealistic, explorable scenes that remain frozen in time. OuroWorld is a mask-free framework that turns any static 3D Gaussian Splatting scene into a 3D cinemagraph: a dynamic scene with vivid, diverse motion looping seamlessly from any viewpoint. A vision-language model infers plausible dynamics and guides a video model to synthesize a reference video, which we lift and complete into multi-view videos. To learn from this imperfect supervision, we propose Inconsistency-Robust Periodic 4DGS: a Fourier-series deformation field guarantees looping by construction, while a Grounded Drift Field anchored at the reference view absorbs cross-view inconsistency. Unlike prior Eulerian methods limited to fluid-like motion, we capture general deformation, object motion, and illumination change. We introduce a ground-truth-free evaluation covering vividness, naturalness, loop seam coherence, and scene quality. On 39 reconstructed and generated scenes, OuroWorld outperforms all baselines and wins 70.8%-99.0% of user-study comparisons. Project page: https://ouroworld.userwei.com
blocks.zh: 最近的3D世界模型生成了光现实主义,可扩展的场景,这些场景在时间上仍然冻结. OuroWorld是一个无面具的框架,将任何静态的3D高斯电镀场景转变成3D影院图:一个动态的场景,有生动,多样的动作从任何角度无缝地循环. 一个视觉语言模型推断出可信的动态,并引导一个视频模型来合成一个参考视频,我们将其提升并完成为多视图视频. 为了从这种不完善的监管中吸取教训,我们提出不一致性-Robust Protect 4DGS:一个傅里叶系列变形场保证通过构建循环,而一个定位在参考视图上的漂流场吸收了交叉视图不一致. 与以前仅限于流体状运动的Eulerian方法不同,我们捕捉到一般变形,物体运动,以及照明变化. 我们引入了无地面真实性评价,涵盖生动性、自然性、环线一致性和场景质量。 在39个重建并生成的场景上,OuroWorld超越了所有基线,赢得了70.8%-99.0%的用户-学习比较. 项目网页:https://ouroworld.userwei.com

blocks.en: Recent 3D world models, such as HY-World 2.0 [ 41 ] , Marble [ 119 ] , and Lyra 2.0 [ 94 ] , generate photorealistic, freely explorable 3D scenes, yet these worlds are frozen in time: leaves do not sway, mist does not drift, and lights do not flicker. Our goal is to bring them alive, endlessly ( Fig. 1 ).
blocks.zh: 最近的3D世界模型,如HY-World 2.0 [41],Marble [119],和Lyra 2.0 [94],生成了相片现实主义,可自由诠释的3D场景,然而这些世界在时间上被冻结:叶子不摇摆,雾不漂移,而灯光不闪烁. 我们的目标是让他们永无止境地活着(图1)。

blocks.en: In 2D, cinemagraphs achieve this by adding seamlessly looping motion to a photograph [ 62 , 32 , 72 ] , but their 3D extensions remain limited. Multiplane or layered-depth methods [ 70 , 56 , 93 ] are pseudo-3D with small viewpoint ranges, while LoopGaussian [ 54 ] and 3D-MOM [ 44 ] use 3DGS [ 46 ] but rely on Eulerian flow, which captures only fluid-like motion and cannot express general deformation, object motion, or illumination change. All of them also require a motion mask and cannot decide where and how the scene should move ( Fig. 2 and 2 ).
blocks.zh: 在2D中,电影院通过在相片上添加无缝回环运动来达到这个目的[62,32,72],但其3D扩展仍然有限. 多平面或分层深度方法[70,56,93]为有小视距的伪-3D,而LoopGausian [54]和3D-MOM [44]则使用3DGS [46]但依赖于Eulerian流,它只捕捉出流体状的运动,无法表达出一般的变形,物体运动,或发光变化. 所有人都需要运动口罩,无法决定场景应在何处和如何移动(图2和图2)。

blocks.en: Video generation models [ 48 , 106 ] synthesize diverse, realistic dynamics that fill this gap, but turning them into a 3D cinemagraph poses two challenges: (1) generated videos are only approximately periodic, so fitting them leaves a visible seam; and (2) a single view cannot constrain a 4D scene, yet generated multi-view videos are mutually inconsistent, so fitting them blurs the scene and produces erratic motion.
blocks.zh: 视频生成模型[48,106]综合了各种,现实的动态,填补了这一空白,但把它们变成3D电影图带来了两个挑战:(1)所生成的视频大约是周期性的,因此相接后留下了明显的接缝;(2)单一的视图不能约束一出4D场景,而所生成的多视图视频却互不相干,因此相接使得场景模糊并产生出异常的动作.

blocks.en: We present OuroWorld, a mask-free framework that converts any static 3DGS scene into a 3D cinemagraph ( Fig. 3 ). A vision-language model [ 99 ] infers plausible dynamics and guides a video model to generate a reference video; we extend this to multi-view videos and fit them with an Inconsistency-Robust Periodic 4DGS. It resolves (1) with a Fourier-series deformation that loops by construction, and (2) with a Grounded Drift Field that absorbs cross-view inconsistency while anchored at the reference view.
blocks.zh: 我们呈现OuroWorld,一个将任何静态3DGS场景转换为3D影院图(图3. 一个视觉语言模型[99]推断出可信的动态,并引导一个视频模型生成一个参考视频;我们将此扩展至多视图视频,并配以不一致性-罗布斯特周期4DGS. 它解决(1)通过构造来循环的傅里叶系列变形,(2)通过地底漂流场吸收交叉视野不一致,而以参考视角为锚.

blocks.en: Since no ground truth exists for this task, we further propose a ground-truth-free evaluation of vividness, naturalness, loop seam coherence, and scene quality. On 30 world-model-generated and 9 reconstructed Mip-NeRF 360 [ 5 ] scenes, our method outperforms all baselines and is preferred in 70.8%–99.0% of user-study comparisons.
blocks.zh: 由于这一任务不存在地面真相,我们进一步提议对生动性、自然性、环接一致性和场景质量进行无地真相评估。 在30个世界模型生成和9个重建的Mip-NERF 360[5]场景上,我们的方法表现优于所有基线,在70.8-99%的用户-研究比较中更受青睐.

blocks.en: Our contributions are as follows: • The first mask-free 3D cinemagraph framework, turning any static 3DGS scene into a vivid, seamlessly looping dynamic scene with general motion, and illumination change beyond Eulerian methods. • Inconsistency-Robust Periodic 4DGS guaranteeing looping via a Fourier-series deformation and learns robustly from inconsistent generated videos via a novel Grounded Drift Field. • A perceptually-aligned ground-truth-free evaluation framework for arbitrary scenes, covering scene quality, loop seam coherence, vividness, and naturalness, under which our method outperforms all baselines on both this framework and the user study.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Cinemagraphs and looping videos. A cinemagraph is a photograph in which selected regions move in a seamless loop.
Early systems extract such loops from an input video by finding seamless frame or per-pixel periods [ 89 , 102 , 129 , 62 , 61 , 79 ] , optionally de-animating static regions [ 4 ] .
Animating a single photograph instead requires a motion prior: stochastic motion textures [ 20 ] , class-specific physical models [ 42 ] , detected periodic patterns [ 28 ] , learned time-lapse [ 24 ] or Eulerian-flow predictors [ 32 , 71 , 26 , 73 , 19 ] , and frequency-domain oscillations [ 59 ] .
Image-to-video diffusion models [ 9 , 124 ] now provide far richer priors, and loop-specific variants cyclically shift latents or positional embeddings [ 7 , 22 ] , animate salient objects [ 108 ] , or condition the first and last frames on the same photograph [ 72 ] , which we adopt to obtain a reference loop.
All of these, however, animate a 2D image plane, and the Eulerian ones are confined to fluid-like motion.
We instead produce a 3D scene renderable from arbitrary viewpoints, with loop closure enforced by the representation itself rather than by the 2D generator.
blocks.zh:
电影和循环视频。 电影图是部分区域以无缝回路移动的照片.
早期的系统通过发现无缝帧或每像素时段[89,102,129,62,61,79]从输入视频中提取出这种循环,可选择去活化静态区域[4].
动画取而代之的是运动前:分形运动纹理 [20],分级物理模型 [42],被检测出周期规律 [28],被学习到的时间跨度 [24] 或 Eulerian-流量预测器 [32, 71, 26, 73, 19],频率-域振荡 [59].
图像到视频的传播模型[9,124]现在提供了更丰富的前作,而循环特定的变体周期性地转移潜入或位置嵌入[7,22],活性地显出显出对象[108],或者在同一相片[72]上设定了第一个和最后一个相框的条件,我们采用这个来获得一个参考回路.
然而,所有这些都使一款二维图像平面发生动能,而欧莱安一款则被限制在流体等运动上.
相反,我们从武断的观点产生一个三维场景,由代表本身而不是由二维生成器执行循环关闭。

blocks.en:
Static 3D scene representations and generated worlds. Single-image view synthesis lifts a photo into a shallow proxy—a point cloud [ 78 , 117 ] , multiplane image [ 141 , 103 ] , or layered depth image [ 92 , 104 , 97 ] —with limited parallax, whereas neural radiance fields [ 76 , 5 ] and 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) [ 46 , 134 , 34 ] reconstruct complete scenes, the latter in real time. They assume consistent captured observations, and some work handles inconsistency with per-image latent codes [ 74 , 81 , 50 ] , uncertainty-based transient removal [ 33 ] , view-dependent illumination compensation [ 125 ] , or ICP-estimated per-frame drift [ 31 ] .
3DGS is also the output of scene generators that build explorable worlds by progressive inpainting and lifting [ 30 , 55 , 21 , 132 , 131 , 140 , 38 , 60 ] , by iteratively refining renders with diffusion [ 51 ] , or with large-scale world models [ 101 , 41 , 37 , 15 , 119 , 2 , 94 ] .

3DGS也是场景出厂器的输出,通过渐进地涂入和提升来构建可扩展的世界[30,55,21,132,131,140,38,60],通过迭接地提炼以扩散[51],或使用大规模世界模型[101,41,37,15,119,2,94].

blocks.en:
Dynamic 3D representations and 4D generation. Dynamic radiance fields and 3DGS add time via canonical-space deformation [ 84 , 81 , 82 , 126 , 120 , 25 ] , scene flow [ 58 ] , factorized space-time grids [ 27 , 10 , 111 ] , per-frame optimization [ 69 ] , sparse control points [ 39 ] , native 4D primitives [ 127 , 23 ] , or per-Gaussian temporal bases [ 57 , 64 , 49 , 16 , 96 , 138 , 14 ] , and now handle casual monocular videos [ 68 , 112 , 53 , 95 ] , even freezing them into a static scene [ 18 ] .
4D generation synthesizes objects via score distillation [ 98 , 3 , 65 , 86 , 1 ] or multi-view video diffusion [ 123 , 87 , 43 ] , and recently whole scenes [ 130 , 107 , 100 , 139 , 121 , 67 , 80 ] , with Free4D [ 67 ] supervising generated views with diffusion-refined renders as we do.
We restrict deformation to a Fourier series, making motion periodic by construction.
Whereas per-image appearance embeddings and illumination compensation [ 74 , 50 , 125 ] explain photometric variation across captured images, our Grounded Drift Field absorbs generative inconsistency as a view-conditioned drift, anchored at the reference view and discarded at inference.

4D世代通过分数分馏[98,3,65,86,1]或多视视频传播[123,87,43],以及最近整个场景[130,107,100,139,121,67,80]来合成物体,由Free4D[67]监督产生的观点,并像我们一样通过分数分数分数进行分数分数分数分数分数分数.
我们把变形限制在傅里叶系列,通过建造使运动周期化.
虽然每个图像的外观嵌入和发光补偿[74、50、125]解释所捕获图像的光度变化,但我们的地底漂流场吸收了基因上的不一致,作为视差的漂移,固定在参考视图上,在推论中被抛弃。

blocks.en:
3D cinemagraphs and scene animation. 3D cinemagraphs splat single-image 2D Eulerian flow on layered depth [ 56 , 93 ] , assemble loops from asynchronous multi-view captures [ 70 ] , or move 3D Gaussians along Eulerian fields [ 54 , 44 ] ; all rely on a user- or network-provided mask and stationary flow.
Scene animation instead borrows motion from video diffusion [ 52 , 118 ] , physics simulation [ 122 , 137 , 36 , 66 ] , or language-model-written motion fields [ 47 ] , mostly within user-specified regions or, as in the concurrent AniGS [ 17 ] , segmentation masks; none targets a seamless loop.
Our method is mask-free : a vision-language model describes the motion, a video diffusion model realizes it, and a periodic 4D representation guarantees an endless loop from any viewpoint (Table 2 ).

blocks.en: Figure 3 : Overview of OuroWorld. (a) Looping video generation. A VLM selects a reference view rendered from the input 3DGS, infers plausible scene dynamics, and prompts a video generation model to synthesize an approximately looping reference video. (b) Multi-view video generation. A 3D foundation model (VGGT- Ω \Omega ) lifts the reference video into a dynamic point cloud, using static multi-view renders to improve depth. blocks.en:
Given a static 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) [ 46 ] scene from any source, we automatically convert it into a 3D cinemagraph.
There are three challenges: (1) obtaining diverse dynamics, (2) guaranteeing looping motion, and (3) learning 4D from inconsistent generated multi-view supervision.
We propose OuroWorld , a 3-stage framework ( Fig. 3 ) including looping video generation ( Sec. 3.1 ), multi-view video generation ( Sec. 3.2 ), and Inconsistency-Robust Periodic 4DGS optimization ( Sec. 3.3 to 3.4 ). See Sec. A.2 for details.
blocks.zh:
考虑到一个静态的3D高斯平板(3DGS) [46] 从任何来源的场景,我们自动将其转换成3D电影.
有三个挑战:(1)获得不同的动态,(2)保证循环运动,(3)从不一致的生成多视图监督中学习4D.
我们提议OuroWorld 3阶段框架(图3),包括循环视频生成(第3.1节)、多视图视频生成(第3.2节)和不一致性-定期4DGS优化(第3.3至3.4节)。 详情见A.2节。

blocks.en: 3.1 Looping Video Generation
blocks.zh: 3.1 循环视频生成

blocks.en:
Unlike Eulerian flow methods [ 32 , 56 , 44 , 54 ] , which are limited to fluid-like motion and require manual masks, modern video diffusion models [ 48 , 106 ] synthesize diverse, realistic dynamics, including approximately looping videos.
As shown in Fig. 3 a, given a reference image I ref I_{\text{ref}} rendered from the input 3DGS, a vision-language model (VLM; GPT-5.5 [ 99 ] ) infers what should move and how, and writes a prompt describing natural cyclic motion (details in Sec. A.2 ).
Conditioned on this, a video generation model (Seedance 2.0 [ 91 ] ) produces a 10-second reference video V ref V_{\text{ref}} with I ref I_{\text{ref}} as both first and last frame, and the VLM filters out results with unnatural motion.
This module accepts any video generator capable of producing approximately looping videos, including prompt-controllable ones [ 7 , 72 ] .

blocks.en: 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4个实验

blocks.en: We compare our method with three 3D cinemagraph methods [ 56 , 54 , 44 ] and one method that brings 3D scenes to life with video priors [ 118 ] . The evaluation uses ground-truth-free automatic metrics we proposed together with a user study.

blocks.en: 4.1 Dataset
blocks.zh: 4.1 数据集

blocks.en: We evaluate on 39 scenes, each consisting of a static 3DGS and a designated reference camera pose. Since reconstructed and generated 3DGS differ substantially in Gaussian density, geometric fidelity, and layout, we draw 9 scenes from Mip-NeRF 360 [ 5 ] and 10 each from HY-World 2.0 [ 41 ] , Marble [ 119 ] , and Lyra 2.0 [ 94 ] (details in Sec. A.1 ). The scenes span indoor rooms, landscapes, architecture, and stylized environments, covering both the fluid and cloth-like dynamics targeted by Eulerian methods and motions beyond them, such as flickering light and twinkling scattered stardust.
blocks.zh: 我们评价39个场景,每个场景都包含一个静态3DGS和一个指定的参考相机姿势. 由于重建并生成了3DGS在高斯密度,几何忠诚度,以及布局上差别很大,我们从Mip-NeRF 360[5]和HY-World 2.0 [41],Marble [119],以及Lyra 2.0 [94](详见Sec. A.1)中分别画出9个场景. 场景横跨室内房间,景观,建筑,和分层化的环境,既覆盖了被欧莱安方法所瞄准的流体和布料等动态,也覆盖了它们以外的运动,如闪烁的光线和闪烁的散落星尘等.

blocks.en: 4.2 Baselines
blocks.zh: 4.2 基线

blocks.en: We compare against four methods. Gaussians-to-Life [ 118 ] lifts video-diffusion motion [ 9 ] to 3D point flow that drives a 3DGS, but does not target looping. 3D Cinemagraphy [ 56 ] and 3D-MOM [ 44 ] animate a single image with an Eulerian motion prior trained on fluid videos [ 32 ] , rendered via a layered depth image [ 92 ] and 4D Gaussians [ 120 ] , respectively; the latter’s optimized 4D output is not guaranteed to loop. LoopGaussian [ 54 ] heuristically moves only Gaussian positions along a bidirectionally blended Eulerian field. For fairness, we also apply the same GPT-5.5 filtering to all baselines. Full descriptions are in Sec. A.4 .
blocks.zh: 我们比较了四种方法。 Gaussians-to-Life [118] 将视频分流运动[9]提升到驱动3DGS的3D点流,但不瞄准回路. 3D Cinemagraphy [56] 和 3D-MOM [44] 动画单相片,先用流体相片训练[32],分别通过分层深度相片[92]和4D高斯相片[120]提供;后者优化的4D输出不能保证循环. 洛普高斯 [54] Heuristic 沿双向混合的欧莱安球场只移动高斯人的位置. 为了公平起见,我们还对所有基线采用同样的GPT-5.5过滤。 完整描述见Sec.A.4.

blocks.zh: 4.3 评价议定书

blocks.en: 4.4 Evaluation Metrics
blocks.zh: 4.4 评价计量

blocks.en: Prior 3D cinemagraph works measure quality against ground truth. Their data, however, is limited to fluid datasets [ 32 ] or object-level synthetic scenes [ 54 ] , and does not generalize to the diverse scenes. We therefore propose a ground-truth-free evaluation framework based on properties a good 3D cinemagraph should have: vivid , natural , seamless loop , high visual quality . These metrics are perceptually aligned, as supported by the user study ( Sec. 4.8 ).

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion and Limitation
blocks.zh: 5. 结论和限制

blocks.en: We presented OuroWorld, a mask-free framework that brings any static 3DGS scene alive as a seamlessly looping 3D cinemagraph. It distills dynamics from a VLM-guided video generation prior into an Inconsistency-Robust Periodic 4DGS. The resulting scenes exhibit diverse motion and illumination change beyond Eulerian flow, loop exactly by construction, and remain sharp despite the inconsistent generated views. With our ground-truth-free evaluation framework, experiments on both reconstructed and generated scenes show consistent gains over prior 3D cinemagraph methods.
blocks.zh: 我们提出了OuroWorld,一个无口罩的框架,它能将任何静态的3DGS场景作为无缝回路的3D影院图来活化. 它从VLM制导的视频生成中分泌出动力学,先入不一致性-Robust Protect 4DGS. 由此产生的场景展现出超越欧莱安流的不同运动和发光变化,完全通过构造循环,尽管所产生的观点不一致,但仍保持尖锐. 利用我们的无地真相评价框架,对重建的和产生的场景的实验显示,与以往的三维电影法相比,取得了持续的进展。

blocks.en: Limitations. Our dynamics are bounded by the video generation prior, so implausible generations propagate to the final scene, although VLM filtering mitigates this. Moreover, completing all views from a single reference video leads to greater disocclusions and inconsistencies at wider viewpoint ranges. Generating multiple reference videos from distinct viewpoints is a promising remedy.
blocks.zh: 限制。 虽然VLM过滤可以缓解这种情况。 此外,从单一的参考视频中完成所有观点,导致在更广的视角范围内出现更大的分散和不一致。 从不同的角度制作多个参考视频是一个很有希望的补救办法。

blocks.en: Our benchmark contains 39 static 3DGS scenes: 9 reconstructed from Mip-NeRF 360 [ 5 ] and 10 generated by each of HY-World 2.0 [ 41 ] , Marble [ 119 ] , and Lyra 2.0 [ 94 ] . Each scene is paired with a reference camera pose, from which the reference image I ref I_{\text{ref}} is rendered and around which the evaluation trajectories ( Sec. 4.3 ) are defined.
blocks.zh: 我们的基准包含39个静态的3DGS场景:9个由Mip-NERF 360[5]重建,10个由HY-World 2.0[41],Marble [119],和Lyra 2.0[94]各生成. 每个场景都与一个参考相机相配相,从中可以提供I ref I_{\text{ref}}}的参考相片并围绕其定义评价轨迹(sec 4.3).

blocks.en: For the generated sources, we select scenes that (a) contain content with an obvious natural dynamic, such as water, foliage, cloth, fire, or light; (b) jointly span indoor, outdoor-natural, architectural, and stylized environments; and (c) include a clean, well-covered region large enough to support the ± 20 ∘ \pm 20^{\circ} orbit camera used in evaluation. The reference pose for each scene is manually selected within this region.
blocks.zh: 对于生成的来源,我们选择以下场景:(a) 包含有明显自然动态的内容,如水、叶片、布、火或光等;(b) 共同覆盖室内、室外自然、建筑和分层环境;(c) 包括一个覆盖面积足够大的清洁区域,以支持评估中使用的±20 \pm 20\circ}轨道相机。 每一场景的参考姿势都是在本区域内人工选择的.

blocks.en: We use all nine scenes from Mip-NeRF 360 and reconstruct each using the official 3DGS implementation [ 46 ] for 30,000 iterations with its default settings.
blocks.zh: 我们使用Mip-NERF 360的所有9个场景,并使用官方的3DGS执行[46]重建每个场景,用于3万个带有默认设置的迭代.

blocks.en: Lyra 2.0 does not host downloadable scenes; it is an image-to-video-to-3DGS pipeline that must be run locally. We therefore generate its scenes with the official code release, taking as input the 15 sample images and captions shipped with the repository, and keep 10 of the resulting scenes. Each sample is a 16:9 image paired with a handwritten caption describing a camera move through a static scene; we use the captions unchanged. Lyra 2.0 operates in two stages: a camera-controlled image-to-video model, fine-tuned from Wan 2.1 I2V-14B [ 106 ] , synthesizes an exploration video at 832 × 480 832\times 480 and 16 FPS along a prescribed trajectory, and a feed-forward reconstructor, combining ViPE pose estimation [ 35 ] , Depth Anything 3 [ 63 ] , and Gaussian prediction, lifts the video into 3DGS. We modify both stages as follows.
blocks.zh: Lyra 2.0不托管可下载的场景;它是一个图像到视频到3DGS的管道,必须在当地运行. 因此,我们用正式的代码发布来制作其场景,将15个样本图像和随存放处发运的字幕作为输入,并保留其中的10个场景。 每个样本是16:9的图像,配以手写字幕描述相机在静态场景中移动;我们使用字幕不变. Lyra 2.0 运行分两个阶段:由相机控制的图像到视频模型,从Wan 2.1 I2V-14B [106]进行微调,将832×480 832\tims 480和16 FPS的探索视频按照规定的轨迹合成,以及将Vipe pose profession [35],Depth Anything 3 [63] 和高斯的预测结合,将视频提升为3DGS. 我们两个阶段修改如下。

blocks.en: Exploration trajectory. The default trajectory, a short zoom-in and zoom-out along the optical axis, produces almost no lateral parallax. The reconstructed scene is then well covered only within a narrow cone around the input view, leaving holes under our ± 20 ∘ \pm 20^{\circ} orbit. We replace it with a dolly-then-orbit trajectory, implemented as an additional preset in the official inference code. The camera first pushes forward into the scene for about 10 s, and then orbits for about 20 s around a pivot placed at the depth center of the input view, sweeping to one side, back through the center, and to the other side while keeping the pivot centered in the frame. The forward push places the camera well inside the scene, and the orbit provides a wide lateral baseline on both sides of the original optical axis. Each scene thus yields a 480-frame exploration video (30 s at 16 FPS).
blocks.zh: 探索轨迹. 默认的轨迹,是光学轴上一个短的缩放和缩放,几乎不产生相向的偏角. 重建后的场景只覆盖在输入视图周围的一圈狭窄圆锥内,在我们的±20 \pm 20\\circ}轨道下留下了洞. 我们把它取而代之的是一个当时的多利轨道轨道,作为官方推断代码中的额外预设执行. 相机先将约10 s推入场景,再将约20 s的轨道绕入放置在输入视图深度中心的一个枢轴,向一面扫去,从中回向,同时将枢轴一直以相框为中心. 前推将相机放置在了场内深处,轨道为原光学轴的两侧提供了宽的横向基线. 因此,每个场景都产生出一部480帧的探索视频(30 s at 16 FPS).

blocks.en: Reconstruction. On these long, wide-baseline videos, the released feed-forward reconstructor produces blurry scenes with many floaters. We instead combine a 3D foundation model for poses and initial geometry with a conventional per-scene 3DGS optimization: 1. Keyframe selection. We select 64 keyframes per video. We first pick 48 frames at equal arc length in optical-flow space and move each to the sharpest frame within ± 3 \pm 3 frames. Since 2D flow under-weights forward dolly motion, we run VGGT- Ω \Omega [ 110 ] once on these frames, interpolate the recovered camera path over all frames, and re-select 64 keyframes at equal 3D arc length, where rotation is converted into an equivalent translation at the median scene depth. 2. Initialization. We run VGGT- Ω \Omega (1B parameters, 512  px input) on the 64 keyframes to obtain camera intrinsics, extrinsics, and per-pixel depth with confidence. We unproject the depth into a colored point cloud after discarding the 30% least-confident pixels and pixels straddling depth discontinuities, voxel-downsample it with a voxel size of 0.006 in the normalized scene units of VGGT, and export the poses and points as a COLMAP model. 3. Optimization. From this initialization, we optimize a standard 3DGS with gsplat [ 128 ] for 30k iterations, using an ℓ 1 \ell_{1} + 0.2 ⋅ 0.2\cdot D-SSIM photometric loss, SH degree 3, and adaptive density control stopped at 2,000 iterations. All 64 keyframes are used for training. When every 8th keyframe is held out, the reconstructions reach a mean novel-view PSNR of 22.1 dB and SSIM of 0.71.
blocks.zh: 重建事业. 在这些长而有广基线的视频上,发行的feed-forward重建器产生了许多浮标的模糊场景. 我们用三维基模型来组合姿势和初始几何学 和常规的平面3DGS优化: 1. 关键框架的选择。 我们每个视频选择64个键框 我们首先在光学流空间中以等弧长选择48帧,并在±3\pm 3帧内将每个帧移动到最尖的帧. 由于2D流出重量不足的前进多利运动,我们在这些帧上运行了VGGT-ship =Omega[110]一次,将回收的相机路径插到所有帧上,并在等长于3D弧长时重新选择64个键帧,在中位点深度将旋转转换为等效翻译. 2. 初始化。 我们在64个键盘上运行 VGGT - 堆积 \ Omega (1B参数, 512 px 输入) , 以获得相机的内在性能, 外部性, 以及每像素的深度 。 在丢弃30%最小的像素和像素的深度不连续后,我们解析出深度为有色点云,在VGGT的正版场景单位中以0.006的花瓶大小来取出花旗和分数作为COLMAP模型. 3. 优化。 从这个初始化开始,我们优化了一个标准3DGS,gsplat [128] 对于30k的迭代,使用l 1\ell\% 1} + 0.2 → 0.2\cdot D-SSIM 光度损失,SH等分3,适应密度控制停止在2000个迭代. 所有64个关键框架都用于培训。 当每个第8个关键框架被保持时,重建达到22.1分贝和0.71分贝的平面小说视角PSNR.

blocks.zh: A.2 我们管道的细节

blocks.en: The input scenes differ in their spherical-harmonics (SH) degree: HY-World 2.0 and Marble scenes are exported with SH degree 0, whereas Lyra 2.0 (reconstructed as in Sec. A.1 ) and Mip-NeRF 360 scenes use SH degree 3. We convert all scenes to SH degree 3 by zero-initializing the missing higher-order coefficients, so that the canonical color 𝐜 \mathbf{c} shares one parameterization across sources.

blocks.en: A.2.2 Dynamic Point Cloud Lifting
blocks.zh: A.2.2 动态点起云

blocks.en: We reconstruct the dynamic point cloud with a single forward pass of VGGT- Ω \Omega [ 110 ] on 45 images: 21 static multi-view renders at t = 0 t{=}0 and 24 temporal frames of the reference video. The static renders are produced by the input 3DGS along a purely horizontal orbit, with azimuth ϕ \phi sampled uniformly in [ − 20 ∘ , 20 ∘ ] [-20^{\circ},20^{\circ}] at 2 ∘ 2^{\circ} intervals and zero elevation and radius offset, so the views are ordered monotonically. The central view ( ϕ = 0 ∘ \phi{=}0^{\circ} ) is the reference view, and the remaining 20 views coincide with the training viewpoints of Sec. A.2.3 . For the temporal frames, we sample 25 sparse frames from V ref V_{\text{ref}} . Since its first frame is I ref I_{\text{ref}} , which is identical to the static render at ϕ = 0 ∘ \phi{=}0^{\circ} , we drop it and feed only the remaining 24 frames, all assigned to the reference view.
blocks.zh: 我们用45个图像上的 VGGT- ship\Omega [110] 的单个前传计算动态点云: 21个静态多视图在 t = 0 t{=}0 和 24 个参考视频的时长框上进行。 静态成份由输入3DGS沿纯水平轨道制取出,方位角-\phi在[− 20 , 20∘ [20^{\crc}, 20^{\crc}]中统一取出,间隔为2∘2^{\crc]并被零高和半径相抵消,所以视图被单调命令. 中心观点 (φ = 0∘ ∘\phi{=}0^{\ Circ})是参考观点,其余20个观点与Sec.A.2.3的训练观点一致. 对于时间框架,我们从V ref V_{\text{ref}}}中抽取了25个稀有框架。 由于它的第一帧是I ref I_{\text{ref}}},它与 φ = 0 ∘\phi{=}0^{\circ}的静态渲染完全相同,所以我们放下它,只输入剩下的24帧,全部分配给了参考视图.

blocks.en: Each image is center-cropped to an aspect ratio within [ 0.5 , 2.0 ] [0.5,2.0] , resized so that its longer side is 512 pixels, and aligned to the patch size of 16, e.g., 512 × 288 512\times 288 for a 16:9 input. All 45 images share the same crop and resize, so the reference intrinsics are transformed only once and apply to every input.
blocks.zh: 每个图像被中-相接到 [0.5, 2.0] [0.5, 2.0] 内的一个外延比, 调整大小使其较长的一面为 512 像素, 并与 16 的补丁大小对齐, 例如 512 × 288 512\times 288 为 16: 9 的输入. 所有45个图像都共享相同的收成并调整大小,因此参考的内在元素只转换一次并适用于每一个输入.

blocks.en: We do not use the camera poses predicted by VGGT- Ω \Omega ; all cameras are taken from the input 3DGS, and the predicted poses serve only as a sanity check. We remove the 10% least-confident points of each frame and align the resulting dynamic point cloud to the coordinate frame of the input 3DGS with an affine transformation.

The orbit camera used for evaluation ( Sec. 4.3 ) shares the same pivot but uses a radius of 0.95 ​ r 0.95r , thereby probing viewpoints off the training trajectory.

All target views share the same initial noise, which reduces cross-view appearance drift.

blocks.en: A.2.4 Inconsistency-Robust Periodic 4DGS
blocks.zh: A.2.4 不一致 -- -- 定期 4个DGS

blocks.en: The Periodic Deformation Field 𝒫 \mathcal{P} uses a single-scale triplane with a resolution of 64 64 per axis. The triplane feature is split into Fourier coefficients with K = 4 K{=}4 frequencies ( Eq. 1 ), and the time-dependent feature is decoded by an MLP of width 128 with separate heads for the offsets of position, rotation, scale, and SH coefficients. The Grounded Drift Field Δ \Delta uses the same architecture and heads, and conditions on the time embedding γ ⁡ ( t ) \gamma(t) and the per-view embedding 𝐞 v \mathbf{e}_{v} instead of the periodic feature. A single triplane 𝐅 Δ \mathbf{F}_{\Delta} is shared across all non-reference views, and views are distinguished only by 𝐞 v \mathbf{e}_{v} . blocks.en: [ 118 ] takes as input a 3DGS, a 3D mask, and a text prompt. blocks.en: For each scene, we generate 20 videos with MiniMax H3 [ 77 ] using its default settings, conditioned on the reference image and the GPT-5.5 dynamics prompt, for a total of 780 videos. Videos are split into non-overlapping 10 s clips, each sampled to 60 frames at 6  FPS and 224 × 224 224\times 224 , and then encoded into 400-d features using the Kinetics-400 I3D network for FVD. Following KID [ 8 ] , we use the unbiased MMD 2 estimator with kernel k ⁡ ( 𝐱 , 𝐲 ) = ( 𝐱 ⊤ ​ 𝐲 / D + 1 ) 3 k(\mathbf{x},\mathbf{y})=(\mathbf{x}^{\top}\mathbf{y}/D+1)^{3} , averaged over 100 random subsets of up to 100 clips. blocks.en: A.5.3 Loop Seam Coherence

blocks.en: Let I t I_{t} be the frame at time t t under the static camera and T T the native period of the method. We sample M = 10 M{=}10 time points { t i } i = 1 M \{t_{i}\}_{i=1}^{M} uniformly within one period and evaluate Eq. 4 . The first term, SSIM ⁡ ( I t i , I t i + T ) \operatorname{SSIM}(I_{t_{i}},I_{t_{i}+T}) , measures whether the scene returns to the same state one period later. The second term averages the similarity between I t i I_{t_{i}} and the other phases in the next cycle, thereby measuring how similar the frames are regardless of phase. Their difference is therefore high only when the motion is substantial and phase-aligned across cycles. A static video has all similarities equal to one and receives MALF = 0 \text{MALF}{=}0 . A video that moves but does not return to its initial state has a first term no larger than the second and also receives a near-zero score. blocks.en: We conduct a two-alternative forced-choice study. Each trial shows two rendered videos of the same scene side by side, one from our method and one from a baseline, with the left-right order randomized. Participants answer four questions per trial, one for each criterion: • Vividness : Which scene looks the most vivid? • Naturalness : Which scene looks the most natural? • Loop Seam Coherence : Which scene appears to have the most seamless looping dynamics? • Visual Quality : Which scene has the best visual quality? blocks.en: The study covers all 39 scenes and 4 baselines, i.e., 156 video pairs. Each pair is judged by 5 different participants, and each of the 30 participants judges 26 pairs, resulting in 780 trials in total. Each criterion thus receives 780 votes, 195 per baseline, from which the preference rates in Fig. 6 are computed. All participants are adult volunteers; participation was voluntary and anonymous, and no personally identifiable information was collected.
